values.note: Forest Service dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 'Camping outside developed campgrounds at any one campsite in excess of fourteen (14) cumulative days within a 28-day period, then relocating the camp within five (5) road miles of the site just occupied without a waiting period of three weeks (21 days)') + Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: dispersed camping 'is free of charge anywhere in the national forest outside of a designated campground'; 'All vehicles must remain on or adjacent to roadways that are open to public travel'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Monongahela National Forest: dispersed camping is free anywhere outside a designated campground (the Forest's 2023 notice).

fees.source: Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/): dispersed camping 'is free of charge anywhere in the national forest outside of a designated campground', read 2026-10-21

summary: No Forest Service page designates this site. Booking set from the Monongahela's dispersed-camping rules: first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 28 (confirms reservable false / fcfs always; adds the limit). Fees: confirmed free, now 0/0 USD (was low 0 only, which reads 'some sites free') from the forest's 2023 notice. FS road layer: FR 47 'Whitmeadow', suitable for passenger cars. No current Monongahela alert or forest order covers FR 209, 27, 47, 49, 233 or 481 (alerts page read 2026-10-21: closures are on FR 18, 19, 76, 86, 701 and a small Elk Run area). Not stated by any agency page: rig size; the all-false facilities/discounts values have no source and were left.
flags: Missing website: Missing agency page: no Forest Service page designates this site. The Monongahela's Camping & Cabins listing has no entry for it, and the Forest's list of developed-dispersed camping areas for the Greenbrier Ranger District (2023 release: Little River FR 17, Mower Tract FR 227/235, Stonecoal FR 209, West Fork FR 44) does not name it. Nearest official contact: Greenbrier District Bartow Office, (304) 456-3335 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/offices).

Road, for information: Forest Service road layer (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RoadBasic_01/MapServer/0, queried 2026-10-21): the pin sits on NFSR 47 'WHITMEADOW', operational maintenance level '3 - SUITABLE FOR PASSENGER CARS', crushed aggregate/gravel. No agency page recommends high clearance or 4WD.
